conclusions: No test label chooses a fit, a smoothing value, an orientation or a winner: LOOKUP tables use training-fold (D_nested) or FIT (D_bank, bank LOOKUP) labels only; every bank recipe and its feature design / scaler is fitted on FIT rows only; orientation and winner selection use VALIDATION only; SCORE labels are read once, to score the oriented D_bank table and the selected bank winner; the B_indep test sample is a separate draw used only by B_indep.

The appended support rows (one per observable wire) carry a dummy label and False FIT / VALIDATION masks; they only receive scores, which give each fitted recipe's exact population AUC (confirmed behaviourally in CHECK6b: bitwise-identical fits with and without them).
C_same and C_nested evaluate the empirical optimum on the sample that estimated it (same-sample by design): this is the estimator being diagnosed, not a leak.

Behavioural confirmation: CHECK6a_estimators_r2.json (call-argument recording of every lookup_scores call, SCORE- and fold-label perturbation, exact re-implementations) and CHECK6b_bank.json (SCORE-label perturbation, support-row non-influence, independent winner rule, population AUCs).

NOTE (not a leak): the D_nested reader is the DRF1 float code; where two cells' shrunk rates are equal as rationals but round to different floats it orders them (DIAG6a: 10 such ties in 4 of 52 own-sample views, <= 2.2e-5 AUC). This is the source reader's behaviour, reproduced faithfully.

NOTE: PROTOCOL.md section 5 lists six scenario cells; edg/bank.py BANK_CELLS has five entries because REF|0.5|skewed carries two bank views (L16, L256) of the same people - consistent with the protocol's pairing of cells 2 and 3.
